1.

The contention of the writ petitioner in the present writ application is that the authorities have
acquired the land of the petitioners in the year 2012 but till date no compensation has been

2. Learned counsel for the respondent Nos. 2 and 3, i.e. the requiring body submits that the land was acquired by the authorities under Sub-section 1 of Section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 by a notification dated 31st August, 2012.
After the acquisition of the said landed property, a report has submitted that the requiring body has paid all the amounts.

Subsequently, it is came to know that the land of the petitioner has been left out and now by a letter dated 28th August, 2025 the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Uttar Dinajpur has informed to the requiring body that the said land has not been utilized.

On receipt of the communication, the requiring body has requested whether the said land has been utilized or not and for this purpose a joint inspection is to be carried out but till date no inspection has been carried out.
3. In view of the above, this Court finds that the matter is to be decided after filing the report by the authorities by way of an affidavit.
